description: Personal settings of one user within one tenant, e.g. how the user navigates the agent topology.
comment: Stored by Heimdall as one document, not as a twin on the node. The DTMI identifies the shape of the stored document.

schemas.description: An agent group a user has starred.

fields.name: AgentGroupId
fields.description: Twin id of the starred agent group.

schemas.description: A user's preferences for navigating the agent groups of a tenant.

fields.name: StartAgentGroupId
fields.description: Twin id of the agent group the agents section opens on. Unset opens the topology root.

fields.name: Favorites
fields.description: Agent groups the user has starred, in display order.
fields.comment: At most 100 entries, each agent group at most once, enforced by the API.

contents.name: AgentNavigation
contents.description: The user's preferences for navigating agent groups, e.g. favorites and the start page.
